promote._source_note: Board 8 is NOT single-repo, so "*" would be a FALSE declaration: a whole-board census of all 333 cards derives 176 sources of this repo and 1 of pupfuzz/agent-roundtable. Naming the repo qualifies every dl_number/pr_number match against the card's own by-ref source, so a colliding ref number cannot promote another repo's card into a terminal stage. Costs nothing forward: all 7 cards currently in Shipped-to-Dev (stage 52) carry a correct by-ref source. A ref whose only match is an UNSOURCED card is named and skipped, never moved — stamp it with `kbcard patch --pr-url`.
